in_hebrew.name: Amoritta
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amoritta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word ‘amor’, meaning ‘love’. In ancient Greece, Amor was the god of love, passion, and desire. The suffix ‘itta’ is a diminutive, meaning ‘little’ or ‘small’. Thus, Amoritta means ‘little love’ or ‘small passion’.
